label: Selection-function semantics for a counterfactual conditional
definition: For an origin and an antecedent extension, the selector returns a set of worlds. The conditional holds if every selected world satisfies the consequent. An empty selection therefore verifies either polarity vacuously. Selection is extensional in the antecedent extension.
note: Analyst semantics for #2052. Success, centering, accessible coverage and nonemptiness for possible antecedents are separate properties. A selection can use accessibility, ranks, or an externally specified intervention outcome, whose adequacy as a causal intervention is open. World selection supplies neither causal production nor strict grounding.
